_about: Clark's ten points (J. E. Clark, 'A Key for Evaluating Nephite Geographies', Review of Books on the Book of Mormon 1, 1989; 'Ten Points of Nephite Geography' and his transects) as features for lab.geography2, written by hand 2026-11-22 before any window was counted. Distances are in Clark's units of standard distance (USD, a day's normal travel over flat land); lab.geography2.clark_unit_km turns them into km. Directions are in the text's own frame: Clark writes that he does not know how Nephite north relates to the compass. Where Clark gives a word rather than a number, the reading chosen here is marked 'finalisation'. Places are names in the text; 'east sea' and 'west sea' are water.

1_isthmus.says: the narrow neck was an isthmus flanked by an east sea and a west sea, separating the land northward from the land southward; oriented east-west, about 4 USD wide (transect I)

2_coastlines.says: the west sea bordered the lands of Zarahemla and Nephi; the east sea is known only along Zarahemla; Manti to the west seashore about 6.5 USD

3_wilderness.says: the eastern wilderness wider and lower than the western; uplands on all sides of Zarahemla; the southern wilderness at least 9 USD wide

4_valleys.says: Zarahemla in a large river basin; Nephi in a highland valley

5_river.says: the Sidon ran northward from its headwaters in the southern wilderness just south of Manti

6_lake.says: the waters of Mormon, a highland lake of some size within a day or two (USD) of Nephi

7_zarahemla.says: Zarahemla near the centre of the land; Nephi about three weeks' travel south (reduced by Clark to about 9 USD); Bountiful several days' travel north ('several' read as 2 to 10 USD at finalisation)

8_nephi.says: Nephi three weeks' travel south of Zarahemla (about 9 USD) in a highland valley, near the waters of Mormon

9_bountiful.says: Bountiful north of Zarahemla and near the narrow neck (point Bountiful a day beyond the city); about 5 USD from Moroni

10_cumorah.says: Cumorah in the land northward near the eastern seashore, probably not more than 6-8 days from Bountiful
